_doc: LANCE-19 batch 4: Light Wheeled APC (RGriffin65), same kit as the armoured car; 2 axles, front steers.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 4, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in apc_veh.json). Moving parts split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (apc_prep.json). The wheels (`wheel_*`) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheels, which were cut from the hull; this own geometry is part of the derivative. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 3 degrees, collapse only above the per-part budget (no Blender collapse on shell soup). WHEELED, 2 axles (the original is a 4-wheel hexagonal-wheel APC). The SAME kit as the armoured car (`armoredcar`), at another scale. The front pair is under `steer_*` pivots. No turret or gun (the original has none).
